_comment: The invented users of the first synthetic study, S1, written before any run. Every person here is invented: no real person, and no composite of real people, is modelled. A profile is a situation and a question, so that anybody can argue with it. The two fields that keep a run honest are does_not_know and leaves_if.
why_these: The first batch is people the lead knows who run Claude Code or ChatGPT, and the site has to win three kinds of them: the developer who installs a behaviour policy in five minutes, the non-developer whose agent sends mail as them, and the person who decides for a team. Two more are there to break it: a security consultant who reads the claims adversarially and will never be a customer, and a junior developer on Windows who follows instructions literally. Two are on something other than a laptop: one on a phone, one on an iPad.

personas.name: Sam Okoye
personas.who: Backend developer at a 12-person payments start-up. Uses Claude Code every day in a monorepo with .env files for four services.
personas.arrives: From a Slack message from the lead: 'try this, five minutes, tell me if it gets in the way'. Lands on the home page.
personas.question: Can I stop Claude Code reading my .env without breaking my workflow?
knows: Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, the terminal, git
that Claude Code has hooks, from the changelog; has never written one
does_not_know: what an ABP is, or riskmandate.ai
what the £50 is for, or whether it is real money
personas.patience: ten minutes, then back to work
leaves_if: installing needs an account, a card or a call
the hook looks like it could block things he needs every day
he cannot tell what the hook will do before he installs it

personas.name: Nadia Farouk
personas.who: Product manager at a 200-person retailer. Uses ChatGPT with the Gmail connector, and Claude in the browser. Not a developer.
personas.arrives: From a post by the lead on LinkedIn, on her phone, between two meetings. Lands on the home page.
personas.question: Can I stop ChatGPT sending an email in my name before I have seen it?
knows: ChatGPT, custom instructions, connectors in settings
does_not_know: what CLAUDE.md or a terminal is
leaves_if: the first screen is for developers
she meets three words she does not know in a row
it asks her to install something

personas.name: Marcus Lindqvist
personas.who: Independent security consultant, twenty years in. Reads vendor sites adversarially. Recommends tools to clients; might resell; will not be a customer himself.
personas.arrives: A client forwarded the home page and asked 'is this real?'. Lands on the home page.
personas.question: Is this enforcement, or theatre? What stops the agent editing its own hook?
knows: Claude Code hooks and settings precedence
managed settings, sandboxes, token scopes, branch protection
does_not_know: who RiskMandate are, or how they make money
what an ABP is in their words
personas.patience: as long as it takes to find the overclaim
leaves_if: the site calls an instruction or a hook enforcement without saying how it fails
he finds a claim the site cannot back

personas.name: Joan Mbeki
personas.who: CTO of a 30-person software company. Fifteen engineers use Claude Code. Holds the budget.
personas.arrives: On her iPad in the evening, from an email from the lead inviting her company into the first batch. Lands on the home page.
personas.question: Can I give my whole team a baseline in one go, and does it hold if one of them turns it off?
knows: Claude Code, git, branch protection, SSO
what a policy means in a company
does_not_know: what being in the first batch commits her to
what the real price will be
personas.patience: fifteen minutes, if it is about her team
leaves_if: it is only ever per person, per laptop
she cannot find what joining commits her company to

personas.name: Tomás Reyes
personas.who: Junior developer, a year into his first job. Uses Claude Code through the VS Code extension on a Windows laptop. Follows instructions literally.
personas.arrives: His team lead told him to 'install the secrets one from the customers site'. Lands on the home page.
personas.question: How do I install the secrets one, and how do I know it worked?
knows: VS Code, the Claude Code extension, basic git
does_not_know: where .claude/settings.json lives, or that it can be merged
whether python3 works on his machine
what a new session means in the extension
leaves_if: an instruction fails and the page says nothing about it
he cannot tell whether it worked
